newsitem.title: USA: Minn House subcommittee advancs bill to buy Twins.
newsitem.headline: Minn House subcommittee advancs bill to buy Twins.

text.p: A Minnesota House subcommittee has advanced a bill for the state to buy the Minnesota Twins baseball club for up to $100 million, the Star Tribune reported Thursday.

The proposal passed unanimously as part of an omnibus budget bill to fund state departments and agencies and is to be considered in the House Governmental Operations Committee on Thursday, the newspaper reported.
Wednesday, a legislative committee hired Deloitte & Touche to serve as a consultant to the legislature on the proposals to build a new Twins stadium, the newspaper reported.

Under the state purchasing proposal sponsored by Rep. Phyllis Kahn, D-Minneapolis, the state could sell shares in the Twins to help finance a new stadium and sell the team off if little response was received, the newspaper reported.
